buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) NDT AND SAFE LOAD TESTING BY NABL ACCREDITED AGENCY FOR 01 NO. Hydra Crane 8T (Sl.n o.4211) at MKD-1 OCM. 1. Visual inspection and checking of all structural elements and recognizing of critical point. 2. Stability checking of structural member with advance digital instruments. 3. Ultrasonic testing at designated point’s with advanced digital instruments. 4. Wall thickness testing at designated points with advanced digital instrument. 5. Load testing (Static and dynamic) and stress analysis for evolution of change in configuration of structur al at designated points with advanced Digital equipment's. 6. Die penetration test at designated points with advanced equipment's. 7. Vibration analysis at designated points with advanced equipment's. 8. NDT of all structural points and sub-assemblies. 9. Compilation and printing of reports (in color) (03 Sets) in DGMS prescribed formats including specificatio n / make of instruments used for testing and suggestion for Stability improvement. Scope of Work of NDT and Safe Load Test: 1.All load bearing pins and all the vital components. 2.Drives with associated welds and joints 3.Hydraulic Tanks 4.Air Tanks 5.Transmission Shafts

6.Cylinders 7.All the vital welds, joints, rivets and other parts 8.Load test 9.Providing Test Certificate Method of Testing of NDT: 1.Stability test of structural members using Acoustic Emission test. 2.Non Destructive Test (NDT) using Ultrasonic flaw detection test. 3.Magnetic Particle Test 4.Dye penetrant Test 5.Vibration & Noise Analysis 6.Section Verification Test 3.
